seed: The canvas zoom control in the video editor, at Next defaults with no flag touched: opening a recording does not bring it up, Command plus does, it sits in the canvas's bottom right corner above the transport, goes by itself five seconds after the last zoom, stays while the pointer rests on it, and a double click on its percent goes to 100%. Then in Edit, with the tool bar and the timeline up, it comes up the same way, clear of both.

steps.note: a recording opened in View: zoomControl must read hidden
Command plus: the control is up in the canvas's bottom right corner, above the transport
still up at four seconds, gone by itself just after five
the pointer on the percent keeps it up past five seconds
double clicking the percent: displayZoom must read 100
in Edit, with the tool bar and the timeline up: Command minus brings it up in the canvas's corner, above the timeline and clear of the tool bar
